'''''Inacc's Crate''''' was a [[Corellian Engineering Corporation/Legends|Corellian Engineering Corporation]] [[YT-1300 light freighter/Legends|YT-1300 light freighter]]. Owned by [[Gol Inacc]], it was the only ship operated by [[Inacc's Shipping]] based out of [[Estaria Central Starport]].<ref name="HS" />
